Summary: [DISPUTE] Member files a dispute from online banking
Description:
As a member, I want to dispute a card transaction from online banking, so that I can get my money back.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Member selects a card transaction and a reason category
- Member enters a description
- The dispute is submitted successfully

Summary: [DISPUTE] Create dispute case with reference number
Description:
As a member, I want each dispute to become a tracked case, so that I can follow its progress.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Submitting a dispute creates a case with a unique reference number
- The case appears in the member's dispute list with its current status
- Opening a case shows its history

As a member, I want to attach evidence to my dispute, so that my claim is supported.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Member can upload documents to a dispute
- Uploaded documents are visible on the case

Summary: [DISPUTE] Agent files a dispute on behalf of a member
Description:
As a member service agent, I want to file a dispute for a member over the phone, so that members without online access are served.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Agent can create a dispute from the agent console for a selected member
- The dispute appears in the member's dispute list

As a member, I want an email when my dispute is submitted, so that I have a record.

Acceptance Criteria:
- On submission, an email is sent to the member's address on file
- The email contains the case reference number

As the credit union, we only accept disputes within the regulatory window.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A transaction older than 60 days from its statement date cannot be selected for dispute
- The member sees an explanation why the transaction is not disputable

As a member, I want provisional credit while my dispute is investigated.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Eligible disputes receive a provisional credit
- The credit is visible in the member's account activity

Summary: [DISPUTE] Prevent duplicate disputes on a transaction
Description:
As the credit union, we must not open two disputes for one transaction.

Acceptance Criteria:
- If a transaction already has an open dispute, filing another is blocked
- The member sees a clear message with the existing case reference

Summary: [DISPUTE] Block card when reason is fraud
Description:
As the credit union, we must stop further fraud on a compromised card.

Acceptance Criteria:
- When a dispute is filed with reason fraud/unauthorized, the card is blocked immediately

As a dispute analyst, I want to resolve cases, so that members get an outcome.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Analyst can mark a case approved or denied
- On approval the credit is made permanent

As Compliance, we need visibility of dispute handling.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A report of disputes can be generated

As a member, I want the dispute list to look clean and modern.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Dispute list uses the new design tokens
- Status chips are color-coded
